scope: Scale-owned report component, own CSS and direct test; no backend/projection/DTO/schema/scoring/instrument/cognitive changes

publicFieldAuthority.disclosureBranches: scale-result.projector.ts includes this score serializer only when numericScores is permitted; completion/unavailable/educational early branches do not expose score context.
publicFieldAuthority.savedVersionSource: scale-scoring.ts makeScore copies description/direction and item membership from the definition used for that result. ScaleResult.toScaleUnitReport consumes external scores; the component only reads already supplied result/score objects.
publicFieldAuthority.noInternalFallback: No new fetch, live registry, raw answer, itemScores or research-data lookup. Counts only, never item identifiers.

implementation.counts: Validate nonempty unique expected set and unique answered subset. Show answered/expected/missing; zero answered is known; absent/empty/inconsistent metadata remains unknown.
implementation.meaning: Show saved description for all scores, including dimensions; otherwise use supplied direction enum; absent direction stays unknown.
implementation.chart: Existing actual-value/theoretical-range marker unchanged; no invented percentages, cutoffs or population ranking.
implementation.styles: ScaleUnitReportCard.css only; wrapping count labels and saved meaning under existing range cards. No global primitive or platform styling change.
